title: Team Planning Board
tagline: Shared spec, in-flight tasks, completed work, and open questions — for humans and agents coordinating together.
summary: One workspace coordinates a whole team
Per-owner task files keep ownership clear
Checkpoint each milestone to preserve a recoverable board snapshot
whyItMatters: Kanban boards are great at state but terrible at context. This recipe keeps state (tasks, owners, progress) and context (spec, roadmap, open questions) in the same shared filesystem, navigable by every agent on your team.
firstPrompt: Read plan/spec.md and tasks/backlog.md, then help me claim the next task.
